items.title: Coca-Cola Stock (KO) May Struggle to Repeat Its Strong 2026 Performance
items.summary: Coca-Cola (KO) stock may struggle to repeat its strong 2026 performance, as reported revenue growth could slow next year and its valuation leaves limited room for further gains. Shares of the beverage maker have soared in 2026, with investors cheering accelerating revenue and earnings growth after a weak 2025.
